## Description

Uses an efficiency ratio to vary smoothing speed: faster in directional markets and slower in noisy markets.

## Where it may fit

Markets with intermittent trends and noisy price action where a fixed moving-average window is too rigid.

## Vehicles

Equity ETFs, futures, FX, crypto, systematic trend portfolios.

## Required data

Close prices, efficiency-ratio lookback, fast/slow smoothing constants.

## Caveats

Adaptive smoothing still lags and can overfit; compare net results to a simple moving-average baseline.
